text.text: {target} has been on your list for a while. You still remember that first date. Tonight {target.his} car is parked right under your window.
{target} has been on your list for a while, ever since the fountain business. Tonight {target.his} car is parked right under your window.
{target} has been on your list for a while. Tonight {target.his} car is parked right under your window.

ok.text: {target} walks to work in the rain. You watch from your window, sipping tea.

fail.text: The doorbell camera across the road catches everything. {target} prints the photo and frames it.

choices.label: Send an anonymous complaint to {target}'s boss

ok.text: {target} has a “little chat” with HR. You have a big, quiet smile.

secret.text: You wrote the anonymous letter about {target}

reveal.text: HR shows {target} the letter. The handwriting is yours. So is the coffee stain.

effects.remember: Got {target} in trouble at work with an anonymous letter.

fail.text: You signed it. Out of habit. {target} reads it out at the office party.

effects.remember: Wrote {target} an anonymous letter. It wasn't anonymous enough.

ok.text: You leave a note on {target}'s car: “We're good.” {target} reads it as a threat, but it's a start.

choices.label: Loosen {target}'s windscreen wipers, just a bit

ok.text: It rains. The wipers wave goodbye at the first junction. {target} never knows how.
{target} is parked on a yellow line. You write the ticket slowly, so {target.he} can watch.

effects.remember: Gave {target} a perfectly legal parking ticket.

title: The Group Chat
text: You've been added to a group chat by mistake. It's {target}'s friends. They're planning a surprise party for {target}.

ok.text: {target} has to act surprised. {Target.he} is a terrible actor. Everyone is disappointed in {target.him}.

effects.remember: Ruined {target}'s surprise party by spoiling it.

fail.text: {target} doesn't believe you and thinks you're inviting {target.him} to a trap. Fair.

choices.label: Change the party theme to “1980s aerobics”, anonymously

ok.text: {target} arrives in a suit. Everyone else is in leotards. The photos live forever.

secret.text: You changed {target}'s party theme to aerobics

reveal.text: Someone checks the chat history. The leotards lead back to you.

fail.text: You change it, but your name shows up as “changed the group theme”. Every single person sees it.

ok.text: You leave. Twelve people see “You left”. Twelve people wonder why you were there.
